faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about web development services for businesses in Patna.

items.question: What is the difference between web design and web development?
items.answer: Design covers how the site looks and how visitors move through it. Development is the build — the code, the content structure, forms, integrations and everything that makes it work. We handle both, so you do not need to coordinate two vendors.

items.question: What kinds of websites do you build?
items.answer: Business and corporate websites, ecommerce stores, WordPress sites, website redesigns, and custom web applications such as portals and internal tools.

items.question: Will I be able to update the website myself?
items.answer: Yes. We set up the content structure and walk your team through it at handover, so routine text, image and page updates do not need a developer.

items.question: Will the website work properly on mobile?
items.answer: Yes. Every site is built mobile-first and checked across phone, tablet and desktop before launch.

items.question: Can you redesign our existing website instead of starting over?
items.answer: Yes. We review what you already have, keep what is working, and improve structure, performance, usability and the paths that lead to enquiries.

items.question: Can you integrate payments, bookings or other third-party tools?
items.answer: Yes. Payment gateways, booking and enquiry flows, CRM and marketing tools, and other third-party services can be integrated as part of the build.

items.question: How long does a web development project take and what does it cost?
items.answer: It depends on the number of pages or modules, the features involved and how much content is ready. We share a written timeline and estimate after discussing your requirement.

items.question: Do you offer maintenance after the website is live?
items.answer: Yes. We provide ongoing maintenance covering updates, backups, security, performance and content changes.
